description: Every upstream source Apprentix tracks: what it provides, how it is accessed, its licence and refresh cadence. 'automated' sources are fetched by pipeline/ connectors; the others are curated by hand or not yet integrated.

sources.name: Austria — WKO Lehrlingsstatistik
sources.description: Apprentices (Lehrlinge) in Austria at 31 December by sector (Sparte), federal state, apprenticeship year and sex, from the apprenticeship offices of the Economic Chambers. National series, 2002 onwards plus 1980/1990/2000 benchmarks.
sources.licence: unverified — wko.at terms reserve all rights (personal use only; storage in databases and redistribution need WKO consent)
sources.cadence: annual (published in January–February for 31 December of the previous year)
sources.permission_needed: WKO's terms forbid storing the data in databases or passing it on without WKO's consent. Ask WKO (Abteilung für Statistik) for permission before enabling.
sources.reuse_note: WKO consent required before republishing (see wko.at Offenlegung).

status.detail: WKO's terms forbid storing the data in databases or passing it on without WKO's consent. Ask WKO (Abteilung für Statistik) for permission before enabling.

sources.name: Cedefop — Datasets (Key indicators on VET; Timeline of VET policies)
sources.description: Cedefop's downloadable datasets: 58 Key indicators on VET for 36 countries (2010 onwards) and more than 1,000 national VET policy developments since 2015.

sources.name: Switzerland — BFS initial VET statistics (opendata.swiss)
sources.description: Learners, entrants and qualifications in Swiss initial VET (EFZ/EBA), split into dual (company-based) and full-time school-based training, by sex and canton. National series.
sources.licence: opendata.swiss terms_by (open use, source must be cited)
sources.cadence: annual (SDL learners in February; SBG-SFPI entrants/stock/qualifications in June)

sources.name: data.europa.eu
sources.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
sources.description: The EU open-data portal, used as a discovery hub: a catalogue of apprenticeship and VET datasets published by national, regional and EU bodies, plus an update watch on Cedefop's catalogue.
sources.cadence: continuous (harvested daily from national portals); refreshed on each pipeline run

sources.name: Germany — BA Jobbörse: advertised apprenticeship places (monthly snapshot)
sources.description: Number of apprenticeship and dual-study places currently advertised in the Federal Employment Agency's job board (Jobbörse), recorded once a month, by type (apprenticeship vs dual study). Aggregate counts only — no ad texts or employer details are stored.
sources.licence: unverified — no API terms published; BA imprint requires permission for reuse beyond information and source attribution
sources.cadence: monthly snapshot (first run of each month)
sources.permission_needed: The BA imprint requires prior permission to reuse its content, and the API has no published terms. Ask the Bundesagentur für Arbeit before enabling.
sources.reuse_note: Undocumented public API (client id from the BA web app); reuse terms unclear — aggregate counts only.

status.detail: The BA imprint requires prior permission to reuse its content, and the API has no published terms. Ask the Bundesagentur für Arbeit before enabling.

sources.name: Germany — BIBB DAZUBI (training-entrant and graduate rates)
sources.description: BIBB's Datensystem Auszubildende (DAZUBI) additional tables: the training-entrant rate (Ausbildungsanfängerquote) and graduate rate of dual VET in Germany compared with higher education, since 2012.
sources.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (as stated in the BIBB workbook)
sources.permission_needed: Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; 'no derivatives' may rule out republishing extracted values in charts. Ask BIBB for permission before enabling.
sources.reuse_note: CC BY-NC-ND: non-commercial, no derivatives — confirm that republishing extracted values is acceptable.

status.detail: Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; 'no derivatives' may rule out republishing extracted values in charts. Ask BIBB for permission before enabling.

sources.name: Germany — Destatis GENESIS 21211 (vocational training statistics)
sources.description: Germany's official vocational training statistics (Berufsbildungsstatistik, 31 December survey): apprentices in dual training under BBiG/HwO, newly concluded training contracts and passed final examinations, by sex, training area and Land.
sources.cadence: annual (results for 31 December published in summer of the following year)

sources.name: Uddannelsesstatistik.dk — Lærepladsstatistik (Denmark)
sources.publisher: Børne- og Undervisningsministeriet / Styrelsen for IT og Læring (STIL), Uddannelsesstatistik.dk
sources.description: Monthly number of new training agreements (indgåede uddannelsesaftaler) in Danish vocational education (EUD), from the Ministry's apprenticeship-place statistics.
sources.licence: CC BY 4.0 (as declared in the service's DCAT-AP-DK metadata); STIL terms of use require the credit 'Kilde: Uddannelsesstatistik.dk' and the retrieval date

sources.name: Erasmus+ project lists
sources.publisher: European Commission (DG EAC / EACEA; DG EMPL for CoVEs)
sources.description: Erasmus+ Key Action 1 VET mobility projects and EU grants by coordinating country and call year (2014–2025), new Erasmus accreditations in VET, and organisations taking part in Centres of Vocational Excellence projects.
sources.cadence: files regenerated daily; new call-year results mainly summer–autumn

sources.name: ESCO — European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations
sources.description: Reference list of every ESCO occupation (URI, English label, ESCO code, ISCO-08 unit group), pinned to ESCO v1.2.1. Used to link apprenticeship schemes to occupations.

sources.name: Eurostat
sources.description: EU statistics on work-based learning, VET graduates' employment, and pupils in combined school- and work-based programmes — the closest EU-wide proxy for apprenticeship.
sources.cadence: annual (LFS in September, UOE enrolment in August–September)

sources.name: Statistics Finland — vocational students by mode of competence acquisition
sources.description: Finnish vocational students, new students and qualifications whose studies included apprenticeship (oppisopimus) periods, by qualification type and sex, from Statistics Finland table 14rw.

sources.name: DARES — apprenticeship contracts (POEM)
sources.description: Monthly new apprenticeship contracts and end-of-month stock of apprentices in France since 2013, by employer sector (private/public) and level (secondary/higher education).
sources.licence: unverified — POEM legal notice (mentions légales) states the site's contents are "des information publiques librement et gratuitement réutilisables dans les conditions fixées par la loi n°78-753 du 17 juillet 1978", but also asks reusers to contact dares.dsypef at travail.gouv.fr; no named open licence is attached to the series

sources.name: CSO Ireland — Apprenticeship Outcomes
sources.description: Number of apprentices qualifying each year in Ireland (by sex and NFQ level) and the share in employment in the years after qualifying, from the CSO Apprenticeship Outcomes release.

sources.name: DUO Open Onderwijsdata — MBO students
sources.description: Students in Dutch secondary vocational education (MBO) at 1 October, by learning pathway — BBL (work-based, apprenticeship-type) vs BOL (school-based) — and for BBL by level and sector chamber.
sources.licence: Creative Commons Attribution (as declared in the CKAN metadata, license_id 'cc-by'; version not stated)

sources.name: Statistics Norway (SSB) — StatBank
sources.description: Norwegian apprentices (lærlinger) and training candidates (lærekandidater) at 1 October, new apprentices, and completed trade/journeyman examinations, from SSB's upper-secondary education statistics.

sources.name: OECD Education at a Glance
sources.description: Education at a Glance tables: share of VET students in combined school- and work-based programmes, and employment rates of adults with vocational versus general upper-secondary attainment. Adds non-EU comparators (CH, NO, IS, TR, UK).

sources.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)
sources.description: Global education statistics: share of students in vocational programmes by ISCED level, share of 15–24-year-olds in vocational education, and government spending on vocational education. Fills gaps for candidate countries (AL, BA, GE, MD, ME, MK, RS, TR, UA).
sources.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (UIS terms and conditions; credit 'Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS)', URL and date of extraction)
sources.cadence: two data releases a year (typically February/March and September)

sources.name: DfE Explore Education Statistics — Apprenticeships (England)
sources.publisher: Department for Education (England), Explore Education Statistics
sources.description: Apprenticeship starts, achievements and participation in England by academic year, by apprenticeship level and age group.
sources.cadence: several releases a year; full-year final figures in November

sources.name: Cedefop — European database on apprenticeship schemes
sources.description: Scheme and country fiches (45 variables; 2016, 2019, 2023 and 2026 updates). The basis of the apprenticeship-schemes dataset on this site.
sources.licence: Cedefop legal notice: reproduction authorised with acknowledgement
sources.why_manual: Web pages only, behind bot protection that refuses automated requests. Curated by hand; a bulk export has been requested.

sources.name: Cedefop — Financing apprenticeships database
sources.description: Financing arrangements for 29 schemes and 54 instruments. Reference period 2016–17 (not updated since).
sources.licence: Cedefop legal notice: reproduction authorised with acknowledgement
sources.why_manual: Web pages only, behind bot protection.

sources.name: Cedefop — NQF online tool
sources.description: National qualifications frameworks in 41 countries, state of play 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024.
sources.licence: Cedefop legal notice: reproduction authorised with acknowledgement
sources.why_manual: Web pages and PDF reports only, behind bot protection.

sources.name: Cedefop — VET in Europe database
sources.description: Descriptions of national VET systems, system charts and 'Spotlight on VET' summaries.
sources.licence: Cedefop legal notice: reproduction authorised with acknowledgement
sources.cadence: about every two years per country
sources.why_manual: Long-form web pages and PDFs; best linked and summarised rather than copied.

sources.name: Cedefop — Financing adult learning database
sources.description: Training funds, tax incentives, individual learning accounts, vouchers and payback clauses (reference years 2014–15 and 2020).
sources.licence: Cedefop legal notice: reproduction authorised with acknowledgement
sources.why_manual: Web pages only, behind bot protection.

sources.name: European Alliance for Apprenticeships — members and pledges
sources.description: About 540 pledges by companies, chambers, social partners and others (2025).
sources.why_manual: Published only as an interactive map and list; no download found. An export can be requested from DG EMPL.

sources.name: European Training Foundation — Data portal
sources.description: Torino Process monitoring and education, skills and employment indicators for EU candidate and neighbouring countries.
sources.why_manual: Dashboards only; no API or bulk download found.

sources.name: EURES — European job mobility portal
sources.description: Job vacancies across Europe, including apprenticeships.
sources.why_manual: No official open API; the portal's internal search is undocumented and its reuse terms are unclear. Not integrated.

sources.name: Education and Training Monitor
sources.description: Annual EU and country analysis, including the VET learner-mobility target (12% by 2030).
sources.why_manual: Per-chart spreadsheet downloads; most series already come from Eurostat directly.

sources.name: Eurostat GISCO — administrative boundaries
sources.description: NUTS boundary files for maps.
sources.licence: Non-commercial use only; © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries
sources.why_manual: Not used: the site draws a tile-grid map instead, which needs no boundary data and has no licence restriction.
